blends.name: Summer roll
blends.desc:
Some call it summer rolls, some shrimp rolls, others may know it as GỏI cuốn or Vietnamese rolls~~

With fresh shrimp, springy vermicelli noodles, soft fragrant pork, crunchy vegetables, and fresh green herbs - complete it by wrapping them all with rice paper sheets! Now you are ready to eat them as is, or even better, dip them in hoisin sauce with peanut 🥜 on it🤤

blends.name: Beef Rendang
blends.desc:
Beef Rendang, is an extremely fragrant West Sumatran dry curry dish that is cooked until fork-tender with blends of spices paste and coconut milk. The beef is then fried in the mixture until the liquid, they would render them under low heat until it caramelizes around the steak, coating it with an amazing amount of flavor.

anyone from across the street could smell this dish and would not be able to resist to have a bite of it! 

Rendang is considered to be in the top 15 of the world's most delicious food!

blends.name: Sate TaiChan
blends.desc:
Sate Taichan is an Indonesian dish that is of recent years been popular. It has an interesting history where it is influenced by the Chinese garlicly and spicy sour sauce.

Sate is typically seasoned meat that is skewered and grilled on top of a bed of coal. However unlike other sate, sate Tai Chan is served grilled plain without any seasonings. The chicken meat is simply grilled as is and served with a dipping spicy garlic sauce on the side. 

It's spicy, tangy, and salty! Once you get a bite you would simply crave for more! 

This dish is found mainly in the capital city of Indonesia, Jakarta.

blends.name: Soy Sauce Chicken Noodle
blends.desc:
Soy Sauce Chicken is a classic chinese dish, that specifically originates from the Cantonese. You would find this dish in most Hong Kong restaurant~ 

While many introduces the dish with the use of hongkong noodle, they are practically made with the same ingredient as ramen noodle. Perhaps the only difference are in the thickness of the noodle. while some ramen are thicker, you would use the thing yellow lye noodle for this, soy sauce chicken dish! 

To make this dish make sure to blend :
1. Something is frying
2. Free Range Raw Chicken
3. Ramen Noodle from Cryptoswatch and Noodsly collab. Link below: 
 https://neftyblocks.com/c/cryptoswatch/drops/95212

blends.name: Tomato Soup
blends.desc:
**Who doesn't love a hearty tomato soup! 

When the weather is too cold, or when you are feeling sick, or when you ran out of food, or when you are having a hangover, Tomato soup is always there conveniently to the rescue. 

There's different types to how a tomato soup is served, some likes them smooth and creamy while others like them chunky and watery.

How do you like them?

Tomato Soup is only available by blending 'Tomato' NFT with 'Something is boiling' NFT.  

Limited to 15.
